title: Put the events of the fable in the correct order
instructions: The events of 'The Raven and the Fox' are scrambled below. Drag each tile into the correct position to retell the story from beginning to end.

sentence.target_label: The Raven and the Fox — story sequence

tiles.text: A raven steals a piece of cheese.
He flies up to a tall tree to eat it.
A hungry fox sees the cheese.
The fox cannot climb the tree, so he flatters the raven.
The fox asks the raven to sing for him.
The raven, proud, opens his beak to caw.
The cheese falls to the ground.
The fox grabs the cheese and runs away.
He calls back: 'You have voice but no SENSE!'

distractor_tiles: The raven climbs down to share the cheese with the fox.
The fox helps the raven build a nest.
